title: Which Mathematical Context Supports Target-Aligned Conjecture Generation? A Paired Ablation Study
abstract: arXiv:2611.18621v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generating mathematical conjectures from natural-language context is challenging because theorem-relevant information is distributed across multiple forms of mathematical context, including definitions, objects, assumptions, and constructions. We study which of these contextual signals help a model recover the specific claim supported by the surrounding setup, using 61 main theorems from 12 papers across four mathematical domains. For each theorem, we redact the result and represent the remaining setup using six context components. A paired ablation design compares full context, six leave-one-out conditions, and six single-component conditions, yielding 793 generated conjectures. Context components were largely complementary: removing one component usually had little effect, whereas retaining only one substantially reduced expected-theorem alignment. translated_title: 哪些数学上下文支持目标对齐的猜想生成？一项配对消融研究
translated_abstract: 从自然语言上下文中生成数学猜想是一项具有挑战性的任务，因为与定理相关的信息分布在多种形式的数学上下文中，包括定义、对象、假设和构造。我们研究了这些上下文信号中哪些有助于模型恢复由周围设置所支持的特定命题，实验使用了来自四个数学领域12篇论文中的61个主要定理。对于每个定理，我们隐去其结论部分，并用六个上下文组件来表示其余的设置。通过配对消融设计，我们比较了完整上下文、六种留一去一条件以及六种单组件条件，共产生了793个生成的猜想。结果表明，各上下文组件在很大程度上是互补的：移除单个组件通常影响甚微，而仅保留单个组件则会显著降低生成猜想与期望定理的对齐程度。局部数学对象提供了最强的独立信号，而结构性（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究通过配对消融实验发现，定义、对象、假设、构造等数学上下文组件在猜想生成中总体互补，其中局部数学对象是最强的独立信号，而仅依赖单一组件会显著降低猜想与目标定理的对齐度。
en_tdlr: This paired ablation study on 61 theorems finds that mathematical context components (definitions, objects, assumptions, constructions) are largely complementary for target-aligned conjecture generation, with Local Mathematical Objects providing the strongest standalone signal, while relying on any single component substantially reduces alignment with the expected theorem.
